components.name: PDFium
components.required_action: 2026-11-25: verified the chromium/8179 win-x64 archive digest and GitHub build attestation. The branch retains the reviewed November advisory fixes and the earlier CVE-2026-110155/CVE-2026-113212 commits. Chromium/8165-8179 add decoder rewind state resets, float-cast-overflow fixes, cycle-safe tree traversal and rejection of unsupported 192-bit AES keys; XFA/JS changes are outside this V8/XFA-disabled build. New annotations are stored as indirect /Annots objects. The V8/XFA-disabled build flags, import library and imported DLL names are unchanged. Public headers only add ScopedFPDFXObject. The upstream license inventory matches the previous package and the local IJG notice-link patch was reapplied. Release review validity is unchanged.

components.name: LibreOffice custom runtime
components.required_action: 2026-11-25: adopted the 26.2.7.3 custom runtime, which includes the 22 advisories published on 2026-11-16 that 26.2.6.3 lacked, among them PDF export CFF font conversion, ODF form control import, protected Basic library loading, PICT/HWP/UTF-16/DIF import and linked-image fetching. Macro, Java, HSQLDB/JDBC, PDF import, AVMedia and mail paths remain disabled in this build. The official core archive and five changed external archives (expat 2.9.0, hunspell 1.7.5, language-subtag-registry 2026-9-17, libxml2 2.15.4, libpng 1.6.59) matched download.lst hashes. libxml2 2.15.4 has no HTTP client; nanohttp.c holds ABI stubs only and LIBXML2_WITH_HTTP is OFF, so local patch 0017 was withdrawn. The embedded zlib remains 1.3.2; its ZIP use is unchanged from the 26.2.6.3 review. The reduced runtime passed the runtime gate, 121-binary network/audio import scan, embedded MD4C 344-case allocation test, fixture and staging smoke with unchanged originals, and direct comparison with 26.2.6.3 across 12 documents/89 pages and 11 official quick samples without differences. Fifteen new upstream regression inputs for the fixed areas converted or were rejected identically without crash or timeout; linked DOCX pictures are no longer loaded from outside the document. Full 3,256-file acceptance was not run by user decision. 2026-11-27: rechecked the official 11 quick samples against the retained 26.2.6.3 runtime (all PDF_EQUAL). Upstream state rechecked for all components: PDFium chromium/8179, MD4C pinned commit with no newer commits or advisories, zlib v1.4, MicroTeX openmath pinned commit, and LibreOffice 26.2.7.3 with no advisories published after 2026-11-16. Windows CI passed on dev after adoption (38913b60).

components.name: MD4C
components.required_action: The tracked upstream commit matches the upstream default-branch head at review time. The upstream security page listed no advisories. Keep the pinned UTF-16 source and the six required local patches. LibreOffice's separate UTF-8 MD4C retains its allocation-failure backport. 2026-11-16: extended patch 0002 with an independent explicit-list policy. Prefix probes are bounded by the source prefix, and quote-only implicit parent intervals have a separate cache. Literal block boundaries and allocation/callback ownership are retained. CLRO enables explicit-list/quote policy by preference; MD uses normal implicit continuation. Artifact hashes include this local change. The release security review validity date is unchanged. 2026-11-16: patch 0004 requires a literal ASCII pipe on CLRO table body rows. The probe stops at the current newline and uses no allocations or callback changes. Inline and tagged multiline ranges are preserved. Release review validity is unchanged. 2026-11-16: patch 0005 disables Setext look-behind heading inference for CLRO. Other callers keep their existing flag policy. The guard adds no allocations, callback changes or source rewrites. Release review validity is unchanged. 2026-11-17: patch 0006 adds exact fenced-code source extents, including empty/unclosed bodies. MD_BLOCK_CODE_DETAIL is an app-local ABI extension requiring a consistent parser/consumer rebuild. Internal leaf metadata gains one offset without new allocations or callbacks. Release review validity is unchanged.

components.name: zlib runtime
components.required_action: Verified the upstream source archive digest and rebuilt the Windows x64 DLL with UCRT64 GCC 15.2.0. This release includes the CVE-2026-85091 fix and other buffer-safety fixes. The upstream static and DLL sample checks passed. Keep headers and runtime paired because the default Windows z_off_t changed. Retain the application's restricted crc32_combine import check.

components.name: MicroTeX
components.required_action: 2026-11-23: reviewed the pinned openmath C++17/Windows subset and XITS CLM2 input. The upstream advisory page displayed no published advisories; this does not establish absence of defects. Retain MIT and complete XITS OFL notices. Auto font discovery, logging and privileged addfont are disabled; the app verifies the exact CLM2 size/digest before parsing it. The compiled subset has no networking or process execution APIs. Local patches bound nesting and expansion, reject process-global user macro definitions, use locale-independent numeric conversion, check dimensions before integer conversion and complete Windows outline rendering/resource cleanup. Source inventory hashes cover every vendored file, configuration and local patch. This is a local integration review, not a comprehensive memory-safety audit. Existing review expiry remains unchanged.
